title: HumBEL: A Human-in-the-Loop Approach for Evaluating Demographic Factors of Language Models in Human-Machine Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the language model's demographic alignment and linguistic age equivalence by administering clinical Speech Language Pathology exams (e.g., CELF5) via prompting, and using automated statistical tests based on Age-of-Acquisition (AoA) datasets to compare model capabilities against human age norms.
